title: Dictation draft
description: Provisional words revise themselves before settling into an editable serif draft.
useCase: Avoid treating unconfirmed speech recognition as final text.
interaction: Preview, pause and reset the incoming words, then edit the finished draft.
reducedMotion: The caret stops blinking; discrete text updates and draft editing remain available.
limitations: Scripted partial and final transcription. No microphone or speech-recognition service.
look: Tan background, a cream note card with an orange top rule, large dark serif text ending in muted underlined words, and a round orange button.
motion: Pressing Preview steps through scripted frames every 850 ms: provisional words, underlined with a blinking caret, revise and settle into dark final text, which then becomes an editable textarea.
adapt: A `requestAnimationFrame` clock in the effect advances `step` through `FRAMES` (final and partial text pairs) every 850 ms; the caret blink is `sf-dictate-caret`. Feed final and partial strings from your speech-recognition events instead, keeping the `textarea` handoff.
